title: Three Kinds of Warp — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Three Kinds of Warp's rich face: three walks that each test a claim the page makes, and the 2D Torus project's own renders laid beside the sections they prove, with the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.

pieces.file: Three Kinds of Warp — rich — obstruction.html
pieces.title: try to break the lattice · a walk in five steps
pieces.caption: **The theorem, measured.** One sine read by one phasor; a shape in the table; the commercial warps; any warp you can draw; and last, the one move that escapes: a speed wobble whose cycle is not the lap. The readout counts the energy between the harmonic lines on an exact lap. Every warp leaves it at zero. Only breaking the period moves it.
pieces.near: The theorem holds for any warp at all

pieces.title: the hands tour on Penrose, as a spectrogram · 2D Torus steward
pieces.caption: **The same fact in the instrument.** The 2D Torus project's Hopf surface parked on a locked 3 : 2 knot, then bent, sheared and stirred in turn: the harmonic lines never bend, only their weights move. At 21 s the coupling lets go, the knot opens, and the lines smear. The steward's measurement: 100 % of the energy on the knot's harmonics under every hand while locked.

pieces.file: Three Kinds of Warp — rich — typology.html
pieces.title: two runners, three ways to keep or lose the lap · a walk in four steps
pieces.caption: **The runners, on the torus and in the spectrum.** One pace; a whole-number ratio, where the path closes into a knot and the sound is still harmonic; an irrational ratio, where the path never closes, with summed oscillators beside a surface to show where the in-between lines come from; and last, coupling. Grey ticks are the lattice the set speeds predict, amber the lattice at the speeds the runners keep. Raise K and the lines follow the amber, then land on one harmonic series at lock. The coupling is the 2D Torus project's own Adler form.

pieces.file: Three Kinds of Warp — rich — piano.html
pieces.title: the stiff string and the Stiff String surface · a walk in three steps
pieces.caption: **The claim, put against the surface it names.** A stiff string's partials alone; then one row of the committed Stiff String surface, read the way the instrument reads it; then the two plucked side by side. Every line the surface makes is a whole-number harmonic. It reaches the stretch by weighting the harmonic below and the harmonic above each target, so the centre of each pair lands on it. See the offer on this section.

pieces.title: Penrose, Kuramoto-coupled: below, at and above threshold · 2D Torus, cycle 7
pieces.caption: **Type 3, heard.** The Penrose surface scanned at 110 Hz and ratio 1.518, pulled toward 3 : 2: drifting, at the threshold, locked, side by side. Rendered by Tools/kuramoto_scan.py, the same equations the typology walk runs.

pieces.title: the ramp, plotted · 2D Torus, cycle 7
pieces.caption: Coupling K ramped from 0 to 1.59 Hz. The slip rate (green) falls through hiccups and stops at K* = 0.80 Hz, where the lock order (blue) and the share of energy on one harmonic series (amber) jump to one: the bifurcation the bullet names, as a snap rather than a fade.

pieces.title: the ramp, heard
pieces.caption: Shimmer, then hiccups, then lock, as the plot above. The steward's scroll entry says neither take had been listened to when it was posted.

offers.what: Type 3 moves the lattice's two generators rather than bending partials off a lattice: with the project's Adler coupling, at any fixed K below lock every line sits on m·ρ1 + n·ρ2, where ρ1 + ρ2 = f1 + f2 and bρ2 − aρ1 = √(Δ² − ((a+b)K)²) (measured on the typology piece's engine, 110 and 121.37 Hz pulled to 1 : 1: at K = 0.5, 0.9 and 0.98·K* every line below 400 Hz, up to 200 of them, within 0.0003 Hz of that lattice and 192 of 200 off the bare m·f1 + n·f2; the 3 : 2 preset the same). Suggest 'bends the lattice itself' → 'moves the lattice's two generators, along a square-root curve, until at lock they collapse onto one harmonic series of (f1 + f2)/(a + b)'; the 'curved manifolds' are true of the paths the lines trace as K moves.

Type 1 is defined as a degree-1 circle map, but the theorem covers more: the warp acts on the wrapped phase, so any function of it stays on the lattice (measured: 200 random hand-drawn warps, 181 of them not circle maps of any degree, all with no energy between the harmonic lines to one part in a trillion). Suggest 'g : S¹ → S¹ with g(φ + 2π) = g(φ) + 2π' → 'any function of the wrapped phase; the degree-1 circle maps are the continuous ones that keep the pitch'.

The detuning sentence undersells the 1D case: two summed oscillators at an irrational ratio already give an inharmonic line spectrum, two harmonic series side by side, not only beating; what the 2D readout adds is the cross terms m·f1 + n·f2 between them (measured at the golden ratio: summed, every line on one of the two series and none between; with a surface, all four tested cross lines present). Suggest '…so detuning produces beating rather than a coherent inharmonic line spectrum' → '…so detuning gives two harmonic series side by side; the surface's cross terms are what fill the lattice between them'.

The theorem is about the continuous signal; a digital oscillator that reads a sharp warp folds harmonics above half the sample rate back between the slots (measured: a saw through a sync window, read naively at 48 kHz, puts 0.013 % of its energy between the lines at 110 Hz and 5.15 % at 880 Hz; the 2D Torus steward measured 18 % on Penrose stir before the per-surface reach fix, scroll entry torus-steward-019). Suggest one clause after 'none of them creates a partial in between slots': 'in continuous time; a digital read that aliases does, as error rather than inharmonicity'.

The Stiff String surface is a type-1 approximation, not type 2: build_catalog.py's stiff_string() (Projects/2D Torus Wavetable Synthesizer/Tools/build_catalog.py:212–235) keeps every row a single cycle and splits each stretched partial between its floor and ceiling whole-number harmonic, so read by one phasor every line is a harmonic and only the weights approximate the stretch (the piece's regeneration of the rows matches the committed 13_stiff_string.wav to 3 × 10⁻⁸; 96.8 % of the surface's energy does not change along Y). Suggest the paragraph say so, and that type-2 placement of energy at m·f1 + n·f2 near piano positions is not yet built; the surface's own page, 13 — Stiff String, already calls it the static-wavetable approximation.

Following the type-3 offer on § The typology: at any fixed coupling a type-3 spectrum is still a two-generator lattice (on ρ1, ρ2), and the piano's n·√(1 + B·n²) lies on no two-generator lattice, so type 3 approximates the stretch the way type 2 does; what it adds is that every line slides continuously with K and the set locks with a snap. Reasoned from the 200-line fit, not measured against a piano target. Suggest 'it bends the lattice itself via the coupling functions' → 'it slides the whole lattice via the coupling, so the partials move continuously as the coupling changes'.
